subject: Renewal: 16→32 GPU Expansion — amended per-hour reserved pricing & throughput safeguards
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sasha Chen <sasha@lumenai.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal discussion — LumenAI dedicated pool (renewal + capacity expansion options)

Sasha — good catching up yesterday. Per our call, LumenAI's renewal is up for mid-July and you indicated interest in moving from a 16-GPU reserved pool to a 32-GPU reserved pool to support the new realtime ranking workload.

I've attached an initial quote (renewal_quote_v2.pdf) that shows:
- 12-month renewal term starting 2027-07-15
- Upgrade path: 16 → 32 reserved GPUs (same instance family)
- Proposed per-hour reserved rate (baseline) and a separate blended ramp rate option

Two asks to keep things moving:
1) Can procurement share any PO or contract template constraints?
2) Any throughput targets (p95 latency / tokens/s) we should guarantee for your primary inference route? Dev flagged the work as throughput-sensitive.

I'll follow up with a revised quote that includes a throughput SLA appendix and a mutual action plan.

Thanks —
Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: renewal_quote_v2.pdf
From: Sasha Chen <sasha@lumenai.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: LumenAI Procurement <procurement@lumenai.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — LumenAI dedicated pool (renewal + capacity expansion options)

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the quick summary. A couple quick items from our side:

- Procurement: attaching our standard terms and the PO template (see attachment). Will need price breakdowns to map to our internal chargeback.
- Engineering: we need a target of 2000 tokens/s sustained for the ranking model at 99th-percentile p95 <= 120ms. Burstable headroom of +40% for 10 minute windows would be ideal.
- Commercial: we prefer a blended-rate smoothing during the first quarter of the term to ease budget season impact.

Can you provide: revised per-hour reserved pricing for 32 GPUs (both straight per-hour and a 3-month-blended starter rate), and a short SLA appendix describing throughput, measurement points, and penalties/credits?

Sasha Chen
Head of Ops, LumenAI
sasha@lumenai.com
Attachments: LumenAI_PO_Template.pdf

To: Sasha Chen <sasha@lumenai.com>, LumenAI Procurement <procurement@lumenai.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Updated proposal + SLA appendix — 16→32 upgrade (quote v3)

Sasha — following up with the revised materials attached: renewal_quote_v3.pdf and throughput_sla_appendix.docx. Key changes from v2:

- Per-hour reserved pricing (32 GPUs):
  • Baseline: $24.50 / GPU-hour (equates to $784 / pool-hour for 32 GPUs)
  • 3-month blended starter: $19.60 / GPU-hour (25% discount applied for first 3 months)
- Throughput SLA summary:
  • Measured at route: /v1/ranking (customer-configurable sampling)
  • p95 latency ≤ 120ms at sustained 2000 tokens/s; burst headroom +40% for 10-minute windows
  • Penalty: service credit ladder starting at 5% for missed monthly SLA (first failure)
- Capacity guarantees: dedicated pool reserved capacity plus configurable burst buffer (shared short-term pool) to meet the +40% window. Burst pool subject to availability; fallback to compatible model variants on severe contention.

Attached mutual action plan (MAP) in the doc: timelines for procurement, signature, migration runbook, and verifying throughput during first 30 days. Summary:
- Week 0–2: final contract and PO sign-off
- Week 2–4: capacity provisioning and baseline validation (synthetic load test)
- Week 4–6: customer traffic ingress and monitoring; SLA verification window

Two asks:
1) Can procurement confirm PO cadence and billing entity so we map the invoice?
2) Engineering: can you confirm expected model sequence length distribution and any planned quantization that may affect throughput? Dev — tagging you for input.

If this looks good I'll prepare a contract amendment with the blended starter clause and SLA appendix for signature.

Thanks —
Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: renewal_quote_v3.pdf, throughput_sla_appendix.docx
From: Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated proposal + SLA appendix — 16→32 upgrade (quote v3)

Looping in a short engineering note on the SLA mechanics and risk mitigations. TL;DR: the targets are achievable with the recommended config, but we should harden the verification plan.

Notes:
- Recommended runtime config: continuous batching + KV cache warmup during the first 24 hrs of live traffic; use int8 quantization for ranking model (saves ~35% token CPU/GPU cost).
- Burst buffer: we'll reserve a small shared pool (4 GPUs) per region for short windows; to guarantee +40% we should formalize an escalation path when burst pool is exhausted (fallback model profiles and follow-the-same-route routing).
- Measurement: we must agree on sampling ratio and client-side instrumentation; recommend server-side sampled traces + client-reported request IDs to avoid discrepancies.
- Risk: extreme tail events (degraded hardware or network) — propose an ops playbook and 2-weekly sync in the first 60 days.

If commercial accepts the blended starter pricing, engineering can commit to the provisioning timeline in the MAP.

—Dev
Head of Inference Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: Sasha Chen <sasha@lumenai.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>, LumenAI Procurement <procurement@lumenai.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated proposal + SLA appendix — 16→32 upgrade (quote v3)

Aditya / team — thanks for the thorough package and the MAP. Procurement and I reviewed the numbers and the SLA appendix. We can proceed on the following principles:

1) In-principle approval for 32-GPU reserved pool under the quoted baseline pricing, subject to an amendment that includes the 3-month blended starter ($19.60 / GPU-hour) we discussed.
2) Confirmed throughput target: sustained 2000 tokens/s with p95 <= 120ms and the +40% 10min burst window for first 90 days; after 90 days we will revisit based on observed metrics.
3) Procurement requests the final amendment and our PO (PO_LumenAI_6789.pdf) attached. They want the contract exhibit updated with the SLA appendix and a clear definition of measurement windows.

Can you produce the contract amendment with the blended-rate clause and DocuSign link? Once HOD signs we will route the PO. Agile ask: can we get the amendment by EOD Monday (2027-06-21)?

Thanks —
Sasha Chen
Head of Ops, LumenAI
Attachments: PO_LumenAI_6789.pdf
